# MidBound Blog
> Person-level GTM insights from the founders of MidBound

MidBound provides person-level website visitor identification for B2B companies. Unlike company-level tools (Snitcher, Clearbit, 6sense, Demandbase), MidBound identifies the actual individual visiting your website — their name, job title, company, validated email, LinkedIn profile, pages visited, and time on site.

## Product
- **What:** Person-level website visitor identification using AI
- **How:** AI matches website visitors to LinkedIn profiles in real-time
- **Output:** Name, title, company, validated email, LinkedIn URL, pages visited, time on site
- **Integrations:** Slack, HubSpot, webhooks, sequences
- **Key Features:** ICP matching, UTM re-engagement, multi-stakeholder detection, real-time alerts
- **Differentiator:** Person-level identification (not company-level like competitors)
- **Trial:** 14-day free trial, no credit card required — midbound.ai/register
- **Target:** B2B SaaS, demand gen agencies, 1000+ US monthly visitors, $3K+ ACV

## Key Claims
- 97% of B2B website visitors leave without converting
- Company-level identification only shows which company visited, not which person
- Person-level identification enables same-day outreach to visitors showing real intent
- Buying committees have 6-10 decision-makers; person-level ID sees them all
- Speed to lead matters — teams that respond while intent is fresh convert at significantly higher rates

## Competitor Comparison
| Tool | Level | Pricing |
|------|-------|---------|
| MidBound | Person-level | SMB-to-mid-market |
| Snitcher | Company-level | SMB |
| Factors.ai | Account-level | Mid-market |
| Breeze Intelligence (fka Clearbit) | Company-level | Mid-market (HubSpot add-on) |
| Vector | Person-level | Mid-market ($399/mo+) |
| 6sense | Account-level | Enterprise |
| Demandbase | Company-level | Enterprise |
| RB2B | Person-level | Mid-market |
